answer: Funding-source dilution: every new agent's gas and stake trace back to a funding wallet, and rewards for all agents seeded from one source are split by the square root of their count. Ten honest agents from ten patrons each earn fully, but a farm of 400 clones fed from one wallet earns like 20. Hiding the trail means buying 400 separate clean funding paths, each a costly signal. A dune of fake accounts kicks up a plume of linked transfers that gives the game away.
